extractions.description: Empirical study of implicit meta-learning in language models and a ConvNet, using two-stage and joint training on named QA sources and an MNIST-derived task, plus model-scale, batch-size, probing, and gradient-alignment experiments.

type.quote: We perform a thorough empirical investigation of this phenomenon

name.justification: The paper introduces and empirically studies implicit meta-learning.
